description: This file declares interfaces related to warning reporting controls within the WPEFramework namespace, including events, reporting units, and control mechanisms for warning categories.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event objects with serialization, deserialization, and categorization capabilities.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface for units responsible for reporting warning events and managing categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Control interface for warning reporting categories, enabling exclusion and configuration.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Exclude a specific category or identifier from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configure settings for a warning category.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the warning reporting control object.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Report a warning event with a specific identifier and associated information.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Retrieve information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Add a warning reporting control to the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Remove a warning reporting control from the category list.
